soru: What are the most important works and open problems in fuzzing of network protocol implementations?

alt_sorular.soru: What are the foundational and classic approaches to network protocol fuzzing (black-box, grammar/model-based, generation-based fuzzers)?
alt_sorular.yeterli: Coverage is sufficient when the seminal black-box/generation-based tools (PROTOS, SNOOZE, Peach, Sulley/Boofuzz, KiF) and early stateful model-based fuzzers are identified.

alt_sorular.soru: How do grey-box/coverage-guided and state-aware fuzzers handle stateful network protocol implementations?
alt_sorular.yeterli: Sufficient when AFLNet and its main successors (StateAFL, SGFuzz, NSFuzz, SnapFuzz, Nyx-Net, Snipuzz, ChatAFL) and their state-identification strategies are covered.

alt_sorular.soru: How are protocol formats and state machines inferred (protocol reverse engineering, model learning) to support fuzzing?
alt_sorular.yeterli: Sufficient when key protocol reverse engineering (Discoverer, Polyglot, Netzob) and protocol state fuzzing/model-learning works (TLS, SSH, DTLS, TCP state learning) are included.

alt_sorular.soru: What benchmarks, datasets, and evaluation methodologies exist for network protocol fuzzers?
alt_sorular.yeterli: Sufficient when ProFuzzBench, general fuzzing evaluation guidelines (Klees et al., Schloegel et al.), and comparative studies of protocol fuzzers are covered.

alt_sorular.soru: How is fuzzing applied to specific protocol domains such as TLS, IoT, industrial control, wireless (Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, LTE/5G), and embedded firmware?
alt_sorular.yeterli: Sufficient when representative domain-specific fuzzers (IoTFuzzer, Snipuzz, Polar/ICS fuzzers, BLE/Wi-Fi fuzzers, LTEFuzz/DoLTEst, TLS-Attacker, firmware rehosting fuzzers) are included.

alt_sorular.soru: How are large language models and machine learning being used to guide protocol fuzzing?
sorgular: machine learning fuzzing protocol message generation
alt_sorular.yeterli: Sufficient when ChatAFL and other LLM/ML-based protocol fuzzing works up to mid-2025 are identified.

alt_sorular.soru: What surveys exist and what open problems remain (state explosion, statefulness, speed, oracles, multi-party protocols)?
alt_sorular.yeterli: Sufficient when major surveys/SoKs on protocol and stateful fuzzing and the fuzzing roadmap are found, with open problems clearly enumerated.

calismalar.baslik: AFLNET: A Greybox Fuzzer for Network Protocols
calismalar.gerekce: AFLNet is the foundational greybox fuzzer for network protocols and is highly cited, anchoring the state-aware coverage-guided approach.

calismalar.baslik: ProFuzzBench: A Benchmark for Stateful Protocol Fuzzing
calismalar.gerekce: ProFuzzBench is the central benchmark for stateful network protocol fuzzing, with a suite of representative open-source network servers.
calismalar.alinti: We present a new benchmark (ProFuzzBench) for stateful fuzzing of network protocols. The benchmark includes a suite of representative open-source network servers for popular protocols

calismalar.baslik: SNOOZE: Toward a Stateful NetwOrk prOtocol fuzZEr
calismalar.gerekce: SNOOZE is an early classic toward a stateful network protocol fuzzer, a foundational black-box and model-based approach.

calismalar.baslik: Pulsar: Stateful Black-Box Fuzzing of Proprietary Network Protocols
calismalar.gerekce: Pulsar introduced stateful black-box fuzzing of proprietary network protocols, a classic model-inference-driven approach.

calismalar.baslik: StateAFL: Greybox Fuzzing for Stateful Network Servers
calismalar.gerekce: StateAFL brings greybox fuzzing to stateful network servers using lightweight program analysis, with no manual customization.
calismalar.alinti: that only relies on lightweight analysis of the target program, with no manual customization, in a similar way to what the AFL fuzzer achieved for stateless programs.

calismalar.baslik: Large Language Model guided Protocol Fuzzing
calismalar.gerekce: This widely cited work introduced large language model guided protocol fuzzing, a key recent advance for LLM-driven approaches.

calismalar.baslik: Nyx-Net: Network Fuzzing with Incremental Snapshots
calismalar.gerekce: Nyx-Net uses incremental snapshots to fuzz a wide range of network targets, spanning servers and clients.
calismalar.alinti: we introduce the design and implementation of Nyx-Net, a novel snapshot-based fuzzing approach that can successfully fuzz a wide range of targets spanning servers, clients

calismalar.baslik: A Survey of Protocol Fuzzing
calismalar.gerekce: This survey summarizes specific challenges in protocol fuzzing and systematically categorizes existing research efforts.
calismalar.alinti: Our study includes a detailed summary of the specific challenges in protocol fuzzing, and provides a systematic categorization and overview of existing research efforts.

calismalar.baslik: Fuzzers for stateful systems: Survey and Research Directions
calismalar.gerekce: It presents the first taxonomy of fuzzers for stateful systems, with systematic comparison, classification and research directions.
calismalar.alinti: In this paper, we present the first taxonomy of fuzzers for stateful systems and provide a systematic comparison and classification of these fuzzers.

calismalar.baslik: AFLNet Five Years Later: On Coverage-Guided Protocol Fuzzing
calismalar.gerekce: This retrospective on AFLNet revisits treating message sequences as seeds and associating each message with a protocol state.
calismalar.alinti: Our proposal to consider a sequence of messages as a seed for coverage-directed greybox fuzzing, to associate each message with the corresponding protocol state

calismalar.baslik: State Selection Algorithms and Their Impact on The Performance of Stateful Network Protocol Fuzzing
calismalar.gerekce: It studies state selection algorithms that prioritize progressive states, addressing limited fuzzing time in stateful protocol fuzzing.
calismalar.alinti: Since not all states are equally important and fuzzing campaigns have time limits, fuzzers need effective state selection algorithms to prioritize progressive states over others.

calismalar.baslik: NSFuzz: Towards Efficient and State-Aware Network Service Fuzzing - RCR Report
calismalar.gerekce: NSFuzz targets efficient, state-aware fuzzing of stateful network services, which stateless coverage-guided fuzzers leave underexplored.
calismalar.alinti: However, existing coverage-guided fuzzers mainly aim at stateless local applications, leaving stateful network services underexplored.

calismalar.baslik: SnapFuzz: An Efficient Fuzzing Framework for Network Applications
calismalar.gerekce: SnapFuzz tackles low fuzzing throughput and state-resetting harness burdens for network protocol implementations.
calismalar.alinti: In particular, stateful applications such as network protocol implementations are constrained by their low fuzzing throughput and the need to develop fuzzing harnesses that reset their state

calismalar.baslik: Stateful Greybox Fuzzing
calismalar.gerekce: Stateful Greybox Fuzzing addresses reactive protocol implementations, targeting stateful bugs and state coverage without specifications.
calismalar.alinti: Many protocol implementations are reactive systems, where the protocol process is in continuous interaction with other processes and the environment.

calismalar.baslik: SNPSFuzzer: A Fast Greybox Fuzzer for Stateful Network Protocols using Snapshots
calismalar.gerekce: SNPSFuzzer speeds up stateful protocol fuzzing by dumping and restoring program context at specific states through snapshots.
calismalar.alinti: SNPSFuzzer dumps the context information when the network protocol program is under a specific state and restores it when the state needs to be fuzzed.

calismalar.baslik: Snipuzz: Black-box Fuzzing of IoT Firmware via Message Snippet Inference
calismalar.gerekce: Snipuzz performs black-box IoT firmware fuzzing by inferring message snippets for mutation from device responses.
calismalar.alinti: Snipuzz runs as a client communicating with the devices and infers message snippets for mutation based on the responses.

calismalar.baslik: Systematic Fuzzing and Testing of TLS Libraries
calismalar.gerekce: This work applies systematic fuzzing and testing to TLS libraries, a key protocol domain.

calismalar.baslik: A Messy State of the Union: Taming the Composite State Machines of TLS
calismalar.gerekce: It models the composite state machines of TLS and is highly cited for protocol state machine analysis.

calismalar.baslik: Polyglot: automatic extraction of protocol message format using dynamic binary analysis
calismalar.gerekce: Polyglot is a seminal work on automatically extracting protocol message formats using dynamic binary analysis.

calismalar.baslik: NetPlier: Probabilistic Network Protocol Reverse Engineering from Message Traces
calismalar.gerekce: NetPlier offers probabilistic network protocol reverse engineering from message traces, supporting format inference for fuzzing.

calismalar.baslik: Model learning and model checking of SSH implementations
calismalar.gerekce: It applies model learning and model checking to SSH implementations, exemplifying state machine inference for protocol testing.

calismalar.baslik: MSFuzz: Augmenting Protocol Fuzzing with Message Syntax Comprehension via Large Language Models
calismalar.gerekce: MSFuzz uses large language models to extract message syntax from source code and build message syntax trees for fuzzing.
calismalar.alinti: we leveraged the code-understanding capabilities of large language models to extract the message syntax from the source code and construct message syntax trees.

calismalar.baslik: The Bandit’s States: Modeling State Selection for Stateful Network Fuzzing as Multi-armed Bandit Problem
calismalar.gerekce: It models state selection in stateful network fuzzing as a multi-armed bandit problem.

calismalar.baslik: Fuzzing for Stateful Protocol Implementations: Are We There Yet?
calismalar.gerekce: This work evaluates whether fuzzing for stateful protocol implementations has matured, informing evaluation and open problems.

calismalar.baslik: Is Stateful Fuzzing Really Challenging?
calismalar.gerekce: This paper discusses why stateful fuzzers are difficult to devise and benchmark, framing open problems.
calismalar.alinti: In this short paper, we discuss the reasons that make stateful fuzzers difficult to devise and benchmark.

calismalar.baslik: On the (in)Efficiency of Fuzzing Network Protocols
calismalar.gerekce: It identifies root causes of overhead in fuzzing network protocols and categorizes strategies, addressing the speed problem.
calismalar.alinti: we identify the root causes for overhead in fuzzing network protocols. After that, we categorize and discuss strategies for fuzzing network protocols.

calismalar.baslik: SeqFuzzer: An Industrial Protocol Fuzzing Framework from a Deep Learning Perspective
calismalar.gerekce: SeqFuzzer applies deep learning to fuzzing industrial protocols, covering the industrial control and ML-guided directions.

calismalar.baslik: Model-Based Testing IoT Communication via Active Automata Learning
calismalar.gerekce: It learns models of five MQTT broker implementations through active automata learning for model-based testing of IoT communication.
calismalar.alinti: we learned models of five implementations of MQTT brokers/servers, a protocol used in the Internet of Things.

calismalar.baslik: Uses of Active and Passive Learning in Stateful Fuzzing
calismalar.gerekce: It shows how passive and active learning help benchmark fuzzers, compare implementations of the same protocol, and improve fuzzers.
calismalar.alinti: Passive and active techniques can help in a variety of ways: to compare and benchmark different fuzzers, to discover differences between various implementations of the same protocol, and to improve fuzzers.

calismalar.baslik: Large Language Models for Automated Network Protocol Testing: A Survey
calismalar.gerekce: This survey covers large language models for automated network protocol testing, consolidating the emerging LLM direction.
